entries.claimSummaryRu: Общие лимиты скорости CABA для calles, avenidas, pasajes/calles de convivencia, быстрых arterias и специальных участков.
entries.notes: Used only for compact CABA speed-grid claims needed by assigned tickets; ticket-specific image exceptions remain explained at ticket level.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Национальные лимиты для rutas, semiautopistas и rutas through urban zones used by the assigned speed-limit tickets.
entries.notes: No Decreto 779 annex-specific sign claim is made in this topic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Velocidad precautoria depends on driver, vehicle, visibility, road, weather and traffic conditions, not only the posted maximum.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.2.1 Adecuación de la velocidad a las circunstancias
entries.notes: Supports the weather and paso-a-nivel learning material without generalizing beyond assigned ticket needs.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA requires low beams twenty-four hours on all autopistas, Av. Gral. Paz, Av. Leopoldo Lugones and Av. Intendente Cantilo.
entries.notes: Included because b-fallback-250 is assigned to speed-limits through the current road-context taxonomy.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA road-context definitions for via publica, calle/avenida/autopista/semiautopista and listed vias rapidas used by Cantilo, Lugones and General Paz tickets.
relevantSections: Definiciones: Arteria, Banquina, Semiautopista, Via publica, Via Rapida
entries.notes: Used for compact road-context prose and CABA fast-road examples already present in assigned tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Banquina is adjacent and parallel to the carriageway on routes/highways/semihighways/caminos and exists for traffic safety, not as an ordinary travel lane.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-197 explanation without adding unrelated shoulder-use scenarios.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Ley 24.449 semihighway/highway context, including semiautopista definition and exit/deceleration-lane rule for highways with semihighway applicability.
entries.notes: Supports autopista/semiautopista route context and b-fallback-315. Does not cite Decreto 779 annex signage claims.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Road type affects speed-limit and low-beam answers in assigned tickets: urban streets/avenues/routes/semihighways have different speed rules, and CABA requires low beams on fast roads named in the tickets.
entries.notes: Reuses existing archived laws for road-type-linked speed and low-beam claims. Route-sign recognition remains ticket-specific without annex/manual claims.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L defines a uniform traffic-sign system that communicates orders, warnings, indications and orientations; regulatory/prescriptive signs transmit mandatory specific orders.
entries.notes: Supports compact topic prose distinguishing reglamentarias from preventivas and informativas.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L sign entries support the assigned ticket meanings for PARE, velocidad mínima, giro obligatorio, carril exclusivo, tránsito pesado a la derecha and contramano.
relevantSections: R.23 Tránsito pesado a la derecha
entries.notes: Used only for sign meanings present in the assigned E3 tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L distinguishes warning/preventive signs, informative signs and transitory signs, including examples used as classification traps in the assigned tickets.
relevantSections: Información turística y de servicios: Aeropuerto, Plaza
entries.notes: Supports trap notes for tickets whose correct answer is warning, informative or transitory rather than regulatory.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Current law/code provisions support ticket-specific statements that some dangerous-place answers are prohibited by normativa rather than by needing a separate visible sign.
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-207, b-fallback-211, b-fallback-331 and b-fallback-411 explanations without expanding the topic into a full overtaking or parking lesson.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L defines the uniform road-sign system and supports the role of warning/preventive signs, including the importance of shape and color for sign categories.
entries.notes: Used for compact warning-sign prose and the ticket b-fallback-306 color/form explanation.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L sign entries support the assigned ticket meanings for preventive/warning signs such as curves, winding road, slopes, narrowing, divided road, roundabout, lateral traffic incorporation, double circulation, schoolchildren, pedestrians and roadworks proximity.
relevantSections: P.20 Principio y fin de calzada dividida
Capítulo VIII Señalamiento transitorio / zona de obras
entries.notes: Supports only meanings present in assigned E4 tickets; route/information/regulatory topics remain outside this slice.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Traffic authority indications prevail over road signs, and signs prevail over general legal norms for the operational hierarchy tested by assigned tickets.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 2.3.4 Prioridades / orden de prioridad normativo
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-311, b-fallback-347 and b-fallback-444 explanations without broadening this slice into a full authority/signaling topic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA priority rules support the incorporation-ticket distinction: a vehicle incorporating into an arteria must not interfere with circulating traffic, while vehicles already stopped/interrupted on that arteria must yield to the incorporating vehicle.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.7 Obligaciones de los conductores que se incorporen o egresen de la circulación
Ley 2148 6.7.2 Otras prioridades de paso, inciso c)
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-389 and b-fallback-440 incorporation-priority explanations; it does not turn warning-sign recognition into a full right-of-way topic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Operational authority/control orders and transitory signaling may prevail over traffic lights; traffic lights replace ordinary unsignalized-intersection priority rules.
relevantSections: Anexo L Capítulo I punto 1 Concepto
entries.notes: Supports the compact hierarchy and transitory-signal-over-semaphore explanations for assigned tickets without adding broader traffic-control doctrine.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Traffic light colors and flashing lights define vehicle actions; left turns on signalized two-way intersections require a specific light signal.
relevantSections: Anexo L punto 32 Significado de las luces
entries.notes: Used for red/yellow flashing signal traps and left-turn tickets b-fallback-191, b-fallback-340 and b-fallback-403.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Drivers must cross level crossings only after checking there is no train and no risk; barriers, red railway signals and rail proximity impose stopping/clearance duties.
relevantSections: Anexo L punto 36.c Semáforos especiales para cruce ferrovial con barreras
entries.notes: Supports assigned rail-crossing ticket explanations and the compact 5 m / 20 km/h / stop-before-barrier logic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: At unsignalized CABA intersections, artery hierarchy and right-side priority apply with specific exceptions, including vehicles leaving a level crossing; speed limits differ for streets and avenues.
entries.notes: Used only for assigned no-traffic-light right-of-way and precautionary-speed tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L sign entries support the assigned sign meanings for railway crossing, more than two tracks, railway barriers, curve prevention panels and movable bridges.
relevantSections: Anexo L P.1 Cruce ferrovial a nivel
Anexo L P.2 Paneles de prevención
Anexo L P.3 Cruz de San Andrés
Anexo L P.24-1 Encrucijada con paso a nivel en giro
entries.notes: Supports only the sign-recognition tickets physically assigned to this topic; broader sign taxonomy remains in other slices.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Emergency-service-like vehicles must warn with lights/horn/cloth or equivalent means; other drivers must yield, and overtaking requires checking signals, oncoming traffic and other overtaking maneuvers.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.5.2 Otros vehículos en servicio de emergencia
Ley 2148 6.5.3 Comportamiento de otros conductores respecto de los vehículos de emergencia
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-093, b-fallback-134, b-fallback-139 and b-fallback-407 explanations without broadening the slice into a full emergency or passing topic.
